data.title: Bitcoin holds below $76K as Binance EU closures add to crypto market pressure
data.description: Investing.com -- Bitcoin traded below $76,000 on Sunday as fresh regulatory and security concerns weighed on the cryptocurrency industry, with Binance preparing to close certain European customer accounts and authorities intensifying scrutiny of digital asset transactions.
